name: Odd One Out
concept: One sideways triangle stands apart from an otherwise identical upright group.

name: Signal Watch
concept: A stream of digits meets a central stop-digit boundary and a withheld response.

name: Symbol Tracker
concept: The same ringed star changes position between two boards while decoys surround it.

name: Target Count
concept: Three obvious target stars among subdued distractors lead to a numerical total.

name: Visual Search
concept: A large magnifying lens isolates the single filled tile in a pale tile field.

name: Card Sort
concept: An oversized triangle card sorts to a lifted triangle in a four-card fan with color lures.

name: Color Stroop
concept: A large color word conflicts with its ink; a curved arrow selects the ink-color answer.

name: Cue Shift
concept: A shape cue selects matching triangles while native numbers and colors disagree.

name: Rule Flip
concept: A large raised shape face pivots over the number-rule face with a single flip arrow.

name: Task Switch
concept: A large seven has two task branches showing its parity and magnitude classifications.

name: Context Fit
concept: A sentence sheet says Birds build their ? while a nests word card approaches the blank.

name: Sentence Builder
concept: Multiple shuffled whole-word chips fly, Birds, can reorder into the complete Birds can fly sentence rail.

name: Word Chain
concept: Follow CAT → TREE → EAGLE, joining each final letter to the next initial letter.

name: Word Match
concept: Two facing speech bubbles pair happy and glad across an equivalence sign.

name: Word Scramble
concept: Loose V R R E I letter pieces resolve to one intact RIVER word-choice card.

name: Code Cracker
concept: A concealed four-peg code sits above a colored guess and filled versus outline feedback pegs.

name: Deduction Table
concept: A labeled entity-by-attribute table carries one asked cell and an attached A-not-triangle clue slip.

name: Next in Sequence
concept: A numeric progression 2, 4, 8, ? follows repeated curved continuation arrows.

name: Order Path
concept: Directed A → B → C precedence nodes feed an ordered A, B, ? slot rail.

name: Rule Grid
concept: A valid 3×3 Latin grid highlights the row and column that force its central missing 3.

name: Equation Builder
concept: Assemble 3 + 4 + 5 on a construction rail to reach the separate target 12.

name: Fast Math
concept: A calculator face presents 7 + 5 = ? above number-entry keys, accompanied by a small stopwatch.

name: Missing Operator
concept: Choose the multiplication tile that fills the operator gap in 8 × 2 = 16.

name: Number Line
concept: Place a movable marker for 40 on a calibrated 0–100 ruler.

name: Value Order
concept: Ascending magnitude steps read 3, 2 × 4, and 12 under a rising ordering arrow.

name: Memory
concept: Scattered flashing positions carry an ordered 1–2–3 recall sequence.

name: Grid Recall
concept: A whole illuminated cell pattern is echoed as an empty remembered arrangement.

name: Pair Recall
concept: A shape card is linked to its letter partner, with a recall loop beneath.

name: Pattern Tap Back
concept: A connected trail of neighboring tactile tiles ends at a tap ripple.

name: Cue Keeper
concept: A pinned symbol watchlist is retained while an arriving matching star calls for the explicit SIGNAL response.

name: Running Order
concept: Faded earlier symbols leave a crisp last-three window, then a recall arrow returns to three empty slots.

name: Sequence Memory
concept: Four colored tactile Simon pads form one console, with one pad actively pulsing.

name: Coordinate Turn
concept: A large compass with a ghost north needle, solid east needle and clockwise turn arc.

name: Fold Match
concept: One raised paper flap casts a trapezoid shadow; exact mirrored marks merge onto the kept half.

name: Grid Navigator
concept: A five-by-five navigation board carries one bold continuous two-turn route.

name: Mental Rotation
concept: Two identical asymmetric polyominoes preserve three distinct block colors through an exact clockwise quarter-turn.

name: Transform Match
concept: Two sparse asymmetric patterns reflect exactly across a visible vertical mirror axis.

name: Color Match
concept: A large physical blue swatch connects directly to its matching blue response chip.

name: Order Sweep
concept: A sweeping stroke links scattered number tokens from 2 to 5 to 9.

name: Quick Compare
concept: Two large numerical cards face one another across a bold comparison sign.

name: Reaction Time
concept: One stationary green signal button: wait, then react.

name: Tap Rush
concept: One active circular target bursts with a tap ripple while prior positions fade across open space.
